what: One item's page, whose top changes with its moment: researching, review, live, offer, sold, shipped and paid, kept (spec/pages.md §6.6).
frame: Who: Sam, clearing out a dozen things (primary); Dana the flipper must still hold (64 items, five sites). They open it from a Sell tile, a Today card or a message, several times a day while something is live.
Came to do: see whether it is gone yet and what they keep; answer the one thing waiting (an offer, a ship-by, the facts of a draft); fix a field the agent got wrong.

Costliest mistake: a price or a sale the person did not mean (accepting, countering under the lowest, posting at a guessed price), a wrong fact going public on every site, or deleting an item with a sale still open.

Ways out (ways-out.md §6.6): fix any field in place and lock it; own photos, add or retake them on a live item, with Clean up (no model) and Enhance with AI (off, marked) as two named choices and Use original (edge-cases §6); type my own price in the Plan; Sold elsewhere; Keep it or Donated at any time; End everywhere; Delete, refused while an order is open.

The person stays in the loop at: every guessed value (dotted until touched); each stop of the auto-list tree, one question on one card, never a restart (edge-cases §7); the offer (accept, or a counter picked from three amounts or typed); a photo change on a live item (Approve names the listings); anything under the lowest they take.
decisions: The top changes by moment and the rest of the page stays where the person left it (pages.md §6.6: one page, five moments; the person learns one layout).

One number first: the amount, then a plain row that opens the sum (Art. 7.10) (Ben round 11: the gradient box was off and sizes were too big or too small; the sum is a sheet, not a second big number).

Photos slide in a pager with dots; each site's row says where its listing differs (price, title, size spelled out, photos cut or cropped) (Ben round 11: 'if theres multiple photos i should be able to slide'; listings are written differently per site (edge-cases §5)).

Review shows where the auto-list tree stopped as one question card; an answer fills the field and the next stop takes the card's place (edge-cases §7 (agent proposal): every stop is a card with one question, so a stop costs a tap, not a restart).

Photos open a sheet with Clean up and Enhance with AI as two switches, at most one on, both off until picked; Use original resets; on a live item the change waits for an Approve naming the listings (edge-cases §6 and ways-out §6.5: the mentor's worry that AI can misstate the item; a change to live listings is public (hand-off rule)).
Lock is a switch in the field's More sheet, and the field's caption says Locked (ways-out §6.6 (attribute.locked); the kit has no lock icon, so one is requested rather than drawn).
Under the Plan or Post sheet the page's foot act is not drawn (C4, one black pill per decision: the act under the scrim cannot be reached and read as a second act).
Every guess on the page is a Guess at the body size, the title in Review too (B31, parts of one name are one size; the sheets over the page use the same size).
